items.title: Bill Matthews Interview, 1959-03-10
items.q: So I got around Kansas City, Missouri, played around there a little while... So I went through Oklahoma... So finally we went there and stayed there. It was doing so good. And we got a wire from Charlie Crest to come on to St. Louis, Billy. I've been knowing Charlie a long time. He's on the boat. He

ctx.x: Red Allen. Red Allen. We call him Biffley. I said he come on back there man, we blowed him out. We blowed him out, so these only had one trumpet, Ora had one trumpet, that was with Joe, that's all. I said Joe called us all kind of little young names as he always did, all kind of little young names and that's a human order had it. He had a few words about it. He wanted some more help. Ora said the jobs don't pay enough to have all that kind of help. I'm going to get mine. So he said yeah, let's get this little boy…
Fess and I got two visits with him.
